svg.text: "LAILA is not powerful because of the model behind her. She's powerful because of the system around her."

g.text: 1. The "System Over Model" Principle
INTELLIGENCE AS AN EMERGENT PROPERTY OF ARCHITECTURE
Most AI assistants are fragile single-prompt wrappers around LLMs, expecting the model
to simultaneously parse regex, manage database transactions, and execute OS actions.
LAILA enforces strict functional isolation: The LLM reasons, Memory manages context,
Deterministic Pilots execute on disk, guaranteeing verified physical truth.
➔ Result: Zero hallucinations of execution and pristine cognitive stability.
2. Reasoning-Action Decoupling
ELIMINATING TOKEN LEAKAGE & PROMPT POLLUTION
Traditional agent frameworks mix conversational generation with JSON tool schemas.
This causes leaked internal instructions, broken syntax, and erratic token output.
LAILA isolates Stage 1 (Symbolic Execution Ledger) from Stage 2 (Human Synthesis).
The model receives only verified physical disk outputs before speaking to the user.
➔ Result: 100% human-grade conversation with 0% unparsed tool residue.
3. Absolute Physical Grounding
ZERO TOLERANCE FOR PHANTOM ACTION OR UNVERIFIED CLAIMS
An AI partner that hallucinates having deleted or created a file is dangerous.
LAILA employs deterministic OS Pilots: after every actuator operation, the system
physically audits disk state (checksums, file sizes, exit codes, process handles).
If a file was not written, LAILA is architecturally prevented from claiming it was.
➔ Result: Executive trust where every output represents real hardware state.
4. Hardware Respect & Zero Idle Drain
DESKTOP EFFICIENCY WITHOUT STEALING DEVELOPER CYCLES
Workstation tools must not hog RAM or spin CPU fans when sitting in the background.
LAILA eliminates heavy Electron bloat in favor of native WebView2 and pure CSS,
guaranteeing 0% CPU and 0% GPU utilization during idle standby.
Context sliding windows prevent memory bloat, preserving fast <1.5s token latency.
➔ Result: Runs silently 24/7 alongside heavy IDEs, games, and compilation jobs.
